critical_code_review_comments: ChatList.jsx ChatRow correctly uses dxRef pattern + e.stopPropagation/e.preventDefault wrapper (`stop`) on swipe-action onClick + onMouseDown/onTouchStart stopPropagation. The previously-broken behavior where tapping a swipe button bubbled into row tap and navigated to /chat/{id} is fully resolved.
ChatRow li uses onContextMenu={(e) => e.preventDefault()} suppressing browser context menu — verified live.
Discover.jsx Popular tab correctly excludes featured ids (no Sienna Vale/Kai Mercer leaking into popular top row).
Home.jsx row-trending and row-popular populate distinct sets (intersection empty) and AuthImage renders external Unsplash URLs directly via the /^https?:// detection.
CreateVoice.jsx cv-submit guard is correct: requires both file (picked) AND name. Verified disabled state when only name is filled.
Chat.jsx options menu trimmed correctly per V11 spec — menu-memories, menu-settings, menu-customize all removed; six remaining items render.
BottomNav hideOn list works for all spec'd routes (/welcome, /login, /signup, /chat/*, /legal/*).
Profile.jsx .profile-input :focus rule resolves to #D8B982 gold border with matching gold box-shadow — palette consistent with rest of app.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 V11 P0 fixes verified end-to-end on the live preview URL. The codebase is ready for the user's GitHub push from a frontend-behavior perspective. Notes for follow-up: (a) When asserting cv-upload-input, use DOM attribute reads (not is_visible) — it is intentionally hidden=true and triggered via cv-upload-btn. (b) /welcome only renders the landing when logged-out; logged-in users get redirected to /home, so clear localStorage('lore_token','lore_user') before asserting nav-hidden on /welcome. (c) Swipe gesture is reliably simulated by directly setting `inner.style.transform = 'translateX(-128px)'` on the '.relative.z-10' child; synthetic touch events are unreliable in headless Chromium. (d) Storage keys are 'lore_token' / 'lore_user' (not 'token').
